title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4GRID - SetOperationDataInput
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4grid/SetOperationDataInput. This class specifies that just the range of a datatype property of the instance is going to be modified. Subclass of SAREF4GRID's own CosemOperationInput; inherits obtainInputFromObis (documented on the CosemOperationInput model and not repeated here).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'SetOperationDataInput'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

obtainInputForProperty.description: Property. It identifies the attribute of an instance (COSEM object) of a class from which the data is going to be obtained. The value of this property conforms to the range of a datatype property of SAREF4GRID.

hasInputDataType.description: Property. It identifies the datatype of the attribute being modified. The value of this property conforms to the range of a datatype property of SAREF4GRID.
